projectDetails.description: Ethena is a synthetic dollar and yield protocol that issues the USDe “Internet Bond” by delta-hedging staked ETH collateral across centralized and decentralized venues.

reviews.text: Ethena is a synthetic dollar protocol offering USDe, a stablecoin backed by hedged ETH positions. Launched in 2023, it provides yields through delta-neutral strategies. In 2025, it expanded to more chains with high TVL. The team is transparent, but it’s complex. It’s innovative for stable yields.

Ethena is an Ethereum-based DeFi protocol that issues USDe, a synthetic dollar stablecoin. Different from USDT/USDC, which are pegged 1:1 with dollar reserves, USDe is backed by a delta neutral position in ETH rather than fiat reserves. When minting USDe, the system buys ETH and sells ETH futures to maintain the peg. In 2025 Ethena’s USDe exploded in adoption (market cap $7B right now), making it the third-largest stablecoin. The protocol also offers sUSDe, a stakeable version that pays yield (around 10% on holdings) and plans “iUSDe” (a wrapper for TradFi compliance). Ethena’s governance token (ENA) runs the protocol.

Ethena is a DeFi protocol that focuses on stable coins using synthetic Dollar and Internet bond. Unlike traditional stable coin issuers that maintain 1:1 peg by relying on traditional banking or fiat reserves, Ethena uses the Delta-Neutral Mechanism. Ehena has dual asset systems which are $USDe (Synthetic Dollar) and sUSDe (Staked USDe) also known as Internet bond. The protocol was founded by experienced team members with strong on risk management and quantitative finance expertise from Athena Labs backed by Top  tier VCs like Dragon Fly, Binance Labs and Deribit.
$ENA, the governance token of the protocol is managed by a DAO. Ethena has very strong and extensive security measures, including multiple third-party audits and a highly-incentivized bug bounty program with a maximum bounty of up to $3 million. In my opinion, the project has good potential. However, the main causes of concern about the project is management of Funding Rate Risk during prolonged bear markets and intense competition from already established stable issuers.

Ethena is quite different it’s basically a self funded stablecoin that actually generates yield. On one hand, that’s neat: its USDe stablecoin has scaled rapidly and it’s reportedly the 3rd largest stablecoin with over $10B supply because people want yield. On the other hand, I remain uneasy about its model: if market funding rates went negative or some central exchanges fail, its mechanism could break. It feels innovative but also like walking a tightrope.

Ethena is a decentralized protocol focused on creating a stable and scalable ecosystem for decentralized finance (DeFi) applications. The platform aims to offer an alternative to traditional stablecoins by using innovative algorithms to maintain price stability while offering users the benefits of decentralized finance. Ethena combines advanced cryptographic techniques with a decentralized governance model, providing a more resilient and sustainable financial system. Although still growing, Ethena shows potential in bringing stability to the volatile DeFi market.
